examples.ar: يَبْعَثُ مِصْبَاحُ المَكْتَبِ ضَوْءًا مُنَاسِبًا لِلْقِرَاءَةِ.
examples.en: The desk lamp sends out a light suitable for reading.
So let them laugh a little and weep much.

examples.ar: أَظْهَرَ المُلِيفُ كَرَمَ الضِّيَافَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ الأَصِيلَةِ.
examples.en: The host showed the authentic Arabic hospitality.
There should be neither harming nor reciprocating harm.

examples.ar: الضَّمِيرُ الحَيُّ هُوَ الرَّقِيبُ الدَّاخِلِيُّ لِلْإِنْسَانِ.
examples.en: A living conscience is the internal monitor of a human.

examples.ar: تَوْفِيرُ الوَظَائِفِ هُوَ الضَّمَانُ لِلِاسْتِقْرَارِ الِاجْتِمَاعِيِّ.
examples.en: Providing jobs is the guarantee for social stability.
